question: Should `agents.defaults.mediaMaxMb` be the uniform pre-provider limit for inline, workspace, and sandbox-materialized references in video and music generation while direct hosted URLs continue to pass through unchanged?
rationale: The patch cleanly implements that interpretation, but the setting’s upgrade-visible scope and the deliberate direct-URL exception are product compatibility choices rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Confirm uniform local-reference cap
options.body: Treat the existing setting as the cap for all locally materialized generation references, preserve direct URL pass-through, and land once current-head proof is attached.

options.title: Narrow or document the contract first
options.body: Adjust the patch or its user-facing configuration documentation if the setting is not intended to reject existing local reference workflows before provider execution.

recommendation.title: Confirm uniform local-reference cap
recommendation.body: Treat the existing setting as the cap for all locally materialized generation references, preserve direct URL pass-through, and land once current-head proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: A generation-area owner is needed to confirm the existing configuration contract; no reliable individual attribution was available from the accessible evidence.
